sources.title: Unsloth - Run and Train Models Locally
sources.snippet: Start Unsloth, load a model, open your project folder, then run unsloth start claude. Swap models in Unsloth without changing your agent workflow. Unsloth also exposes an OpenAI-compatible API, so existing apps, scripts and SDKs can connect to your local models through a familiar interface.

sources.title: Connect OpenAI to Unsloth: Run GPT Models in Local Chat
sources.snippet: Learn how to connect OpenAI models, including GPT-5.5 to Unsloth so you can chat with all of them in an open-source local UI chat interface. By connecting your OpenAI API key, you can run GPT models inside Unsloth with features like web search, tool-calling, code execution, image generation, reusable code containers, and prompt caching.
